findings.source_passage: but new sails were coming on board, and bolts of canvas, and coils of rigging; in short, everything betokened that the ship's preparations were hurrying to a close
findings.why_it_matters: The original's cumulative list rhythm and the phrase 'everything betokened that the ship's preparations were hurrying to a close' establish the chapter's opening tempo; the draft compresses to a bare summary, losing the Melvillean catalogue voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'everything betokened that the ship's preparations were hurrying to a close' to preserve the rhetorical cadence.

findings.source_passage: Every one knows what a multitude of things—beds, sauce-pans, knives and forks, shovels and tongs, napkins, nut-crackers, and what not, are indispensable to the business of housekeeping
findings.why_it_matters: 'Napkins, nut-crackers' are deliberately comic details that anchor Melville's extended housekeeping analogy; dropping them strips the ironic domesticity that makes the comparison work.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'napkins, nut-crackers' to the list so the comic bathos of the catalogue is intact.

findings.source_passage: far from all grocers, costermongers, doctors, bakers, and bankers. And though this also holds true of merchant vessels, yet not by any means to the same extent as with whalemen
findings.why_it_matters: The list of shore-based providers ('costermongers, doctors, bakers, and bankers') and the explicit comparison with merchant vessels are the substance of Melville's argument for why whalers must over-provision; the draft leaves only the conclusion without the reasoning.
findings.suggested_fix: Add at least the 'far from all grocers, costermongers, doctors, bakers, and bankers' list and the merchant-vessel qualification to preserve the analytic texture.

findings.source_passage: a lean old lady of a most determined and indefatigable spirit, but withal very kindhearted, who seemed resolved that, if she could help it, nothing should be found wanting in the Pequod
findings.why_it_matters: The character sketch of Aunt Charity ('lean old lady… determined and indefatigable… kindhearted') is the narrative introduction of a named figure; its absence reduces her to a label rather than a rendered person.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the brief character sketch before the list of her errands.

findings.source_passage: Peleg came hobbling out of his whalebone den, roaring at the men down the hatchways, roaring up to the riggers at the mast-head, and then concluded by roaring back into his wigwam
findings.why_it_matters: The triple 'roaring' anaphora is a small set-piece of comic characterization for Peleg; the draft collapses it into a single earlier mention ('roaring from his whalebone den'), losing the deliberate comedic escalation.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the triple-roaring sequence in the Peleg/Bildad paragraph to preserve the comic rhythm.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; three medium-severity voice-flattenings (catalogue truncation, absent reasoning for the housekeeping analogy, Peleg's triple-roaring set-piece lost) and two low-severity character-sketch elisions, none individually triggering regeneration under the rubric.
